content: InstructorLite (hex: instructor_lite, github.com/martosaur/instructor_lite) generates JSON schema from an Ecto schema and coerces LLM output into that Ecto struct; supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Chat-Completions-compatible APIs. As of v1.2.0 the Gemini adapter uses Gemini's native responseJsonSchema parameter (no more manual JSON-schema workarounds). Typical call: InstructorLite.instruct(params, response_model: MyApp.Search.ParsedQuery, adapter: InstructorLite.Adapters.Gemini, adapter_context: [api_key: key]) returning {:ok, %ParsedQuery{}}. This is the mechanism for turning free-text Spanish queries into structured filter/embedding-query parameters inside an Oban job (never inline in handle_event).
